I localized the duplicate actions to [UserInfo.tsx](/app/src/components/views/right_panel/UserInfo.tsx:612). Kick, Ban, and Mute have no pending guard or disabled prop. Kick and Ban call `startUpdating()` only after confirmation, so rapid activations can open multiple dialogs before any request starts. The shared update count drives a spinner, but does not disable the buttons.

The likely fix belongs in `RoomAdminToolsContainer` and the three action handlers: acquire a synchronous lock for the target member before opening a dialog, disable all three buttons while it is held, and release it on cancellation, success, or failure. Each handler should await its operation and use a final cleanup path. [AccessibleButton.tsx](/app/src/components/views/elements/AccessibleButton.tsx:108) already applies both `disabled` and `aria-disabled` and suppresses activation when passed `disabled={true}`.

I did not modify source or tests because this pass is restricted to fault localization; the issue remains unresolved.
